payload.author: claude
payload.body: Retention now covers all growth-prone runtime cache/log tables: idempotency_keys + devtools_events + platform_events (pre-existing) and expired auth_sessions (this change — SessionStore.pruneExpired + boot/15min timer). Durable stream-store retention deliberately deferred to FR-145: stream events are source-of-truth data needing a per-stream policy (ephemeral/capped, cursor-safe), not a blanket prune. Closing FR-42 as the runtime-table retention goal; stream-store tracked separately.
